column1: Luis Arraez leads the slate with elite hit probability, batting leadoff at home for San Francisco against Hayden Wesneski, who offers a favorable platoon matchup and has allowed limited hits to lefties this season. Arraez’s steady approach and high rate of games with a hit make him a reliable anchor for streaks. The next-best option is Arraez again, this time hitting cleanup on the road for St. Louis, also with a strong matchup and consistent track record. Yandy Diaz and Jake McCarthy are viable alternatives, but Arraez’s combination of consistency and matchup stands out.
